title: Weight caps and 1/N for the 15-sleeve futures book, walk-forward selection

candidates.CAP20: SW with each weight capped at 20% (excess redistributed pro rata, iterated)
candidates.EQR: equal risk: w ~ 1/sd for sleeves with positive fit-period Sharpe
candidates.EW: 1/N over sleeves with positive fit-period Sharpe (no vol scaling)

selection: weights fitted on 2010-06..2017-12, book Sharpe 2018-22 (10% target, 60d)
judgement: chosen candidate refitted on 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.137; adopt only if not SW and higher
